name: Erosion of Will (Psionic)
body:
When you attack with a piercing or slashing weapon, you weaken your opponent’s will.

Prerequisite: Elan.

Benefit: Whenever you threaten a creature with a critical hit with a melee or ranged (regardless of whether you confirm the critical hit or not), you can expend your psionic focus to cause that creature to suffer a –2 penalty on Will saves for the next three rounds.
